enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Extends legs. Remains still. Turns to back. Moves arm under pillow. Remains asleep. Breathes slowly. Shifts legs. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning hygiene routine: washing face, brushing teeth, showering
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Removes clothes. Steps into shower. Turns on shower. Washes body with soap. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around waist. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Picks up face wash. Applies to face. Rinses face with water. Dries face with towel. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs, milk, bread, and butter. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out plate, bowl, and utensils. Closes cupboard. Opens drawer. Takes out frying pan. Closes drawer. Places pan on induction cooker. Turns on induction cooker. Cracks eggs into pan. Adds milk to bowl. Adds bread to toaster. Presses toaster lever. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Stir eggs. Turns off induction cooker. Removes eggs from pan. Places eggs on plate. Toaster pops. Removes toast. Places toast on plate. Pours milk into glass. Pours hot water into cup. Adds tea bag. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Drinks tea. Stands up. Places dishes in sink. Turns on tap. Washes dishes. Turns off tap. Places dishes in dishwasher. Turns off light. Walks out of kitchen.

Walks to car. Unlocks car. Opens car door. Sits in driver seat. Fastens seatbelt. Starts engine. Drives to grocery store. Parks car. Unfastens seatbelt. Opens car door. Gets out. Locks car. Walks into store. Picks up shopping cart. Walks through aisles. Selects vegetables. Places in cart. Selects fruits. Places in cart. Selects dairy products. Places in cart. Selects meat. Places in cart. Proceeds to checkout. Places items on conveyor belt. Pays cashier. Bags items. Places bags in cart. Walks to car. Unlocks car. Loads bags into trunk. Closes trunk. Opens car door. Sits in driver seat. Fastens seatbelt. Starts engine. Drives home. Parks car. Unfastens seatbelt. Opens car door. Gets out. Opens trunk. Takes out bags. Carries bags to house. Enters house.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries and organizing the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen carrying bags. Places bags on counter. Opens refrigerator. Takes items out of bags. Places vegetables in crisper drawer. Places fruits in drawer. Places dairy products on shelf. Places meat in meat compartment. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out dry goods from bags. Places pasta in cupboard. Places rice in cupboard. Places cereal in cupboard. Closes cupboard. Opens drawer. Places utensils in drawer. Closes drawer. Breaks down bags. Folds bags. Places bags in recycling bin. Wipes counter with cloth. Turns off light. Walks out of kitchen.

Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread, lettuce, tomato, cheese, and ham. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out plate and knife. Closes cupboard. Opens drawer. Takes out cutting board. Closes drawer. Places bread on cutting board. Spreads mayonnaise on bread. Places lettuce on bread. Slices tomato. Places tomato on bread. Places cheese on bread. Places ham on bread. Places second slice of bread on top. Cuts sandwich in half. Places sandwich on plate. Opens refrigerator. Takes out juice. Closes refrigerator. Pours juice into glass. Sits at table. Eats sandwich. Drinks juice. Stands up. Places plate and glass in sink. Turns on tap. Washes plate and glass. Turns off tap. Places items in dishwasher. Turns off light. Walks out of kitchen.

Walks into living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Flips through channels. Stops on news channel. Watches news. Picks up book from coffee table. Opens book to bookmark. Reads pages. Closes book. Places book on coffee table. Picks up remote. Changes channel to movie. Watches movie. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out water bottle. Closes refrigerator. Walks back to living room. Sits on couch. Drinks water. Places water bottle on coffee table. Continues watching movie. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads pages. Closes book. Places book on coffee table. Turns off TV. Stands up. Walks out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking in the park and doing outdoor exercise
enriched_activities.desc: Walks out of house. Walks to park. Enters park. Walks along path. Stops at bench. Places hands on hips. Does stretches. Bends forward. Touches toes. Stands up. Raises arms. Does jumping jacks. Drops to ground. Does push-ups. Stands up. Does squats. Jogs along path. Stops. Walks to water fountain. Drinks water. Walks back home. Enters house.

Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Washes hands with soap. Rinses hands. Turns off tap. Turns on tap. Washes face with water. Turns off tap. Dries face with towel. Removes clothes. Steps into shower. Turns on shower. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around waist. Puts on clean clothes. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer for personal projects and planning
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens laptop. Presses power button. Waits for laptop to boot. Enters password. Opens project management software. Creates new task. Types task description. Sets due date. Saves task. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to email. Opens calendar. Schedules meeting. Closes calendar. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Replies to message. Places phone on desk. Opens document. Types notes. Saves document. Closes laptop. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up. Walks out of bedroom.

Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out chicken, vegetables, and sauce. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out pot and pan. Closes cupboard. Opens drawer. Takes out knife and cutting board. Closes drawer. Places cutting board on counter. Cuts vegetables. Places pot on stove. Turns on stove. Adds water to pot. Adds vegetables to pot. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Adds oil to pan. Adds chicken to pan. Cooks chicken. Adds sauce to chicken. Stirs pot. Turns off stove. Removes pot from stove. Removes pan from stove. Places chicken on plate. Places vegetables on plate. Turns off light. Walks out of kitchen.

Walks into kitchen. Sits at table. Places napkin on lap. Picks up fork. Cuts chicken. Eats chicken. Picks up spoon. Eats vegetables. Drinks water. Continues eating. Places fork and spoon on plate. Stands up. Places plate in sink. Turns on tap. Washes plate. Turns off tap. Places plate in dishwasher. Turns off light. Walks out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure: watching TV and playing video games
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Turns on game console. Picks up controller. Selects game. Starts game. Plays game. Pauses game. Places controller on couch. Watches TV. Picks up controller. Resumes game. Plays game. Finishes game. Turns off game console. Turns off TV. Stands up. Walks out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down: reading and using phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Sits on bed. Picks up book from nightstand. Opens book to bookmark. Reads pages. Closes book. Places book on nightstand. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Checks social media. Scrolls through feed. Likes post. Comments on post. Locks phone. Places phone on nightstand. Turns on fan. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes.

Gets out of bed. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom. Removes clothes. Puts on pajamas. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Turns to side. Closes eyes. Falls asleep.
